summary: F19 is closed: the contrast tests now require a computed ratio of at least 4.5. F20 blocks acceptance because background resolution skips unsupported colours and composites translucent backgrounds against white instead of the resolved ancestor.
blocking_findings: F20 [Blocker] review-a: resolvedBackground in fixtures/contrast.ts:179–196 does not compute the actual backdrop for every supported case. It blends the first translucent background over PAGE_BACKGROUND instead of the next painted ancestor, and catches unsupported background colours as if they were transparent before falling back to an ancestor or white. This can report a passing ratio for a failing rendered contrast.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD returned b2e65587828c534b590799c55b649da108f9ee25, equal to role_base_sha and audited_head_sha.

F19 withdrawn: contrastOf now compares the computed foreground with resolvedBackground and both changed R2 tests require a ratio of at least 4.5. The sky-300 contact mutation fails the target assertion, and contrast-fixture.test.ts pins the rgb(120,120,120) on #faf9f7 ratio below 4.5.

The exact Phase 3 diff 8a126f612abcc258c6c6711d6ac03fa085bbcbff..b2e65587828c534b590799c55b649da108f9ee25 changes test files, test fixtures, and plan.md only. No production file or classification row changed.
The targeted Vitest run passed 11 files and 55 tests, including contrast-fixture.test.ts, both contrast tests, the remaining R2 files, and the blog merge test.
gate-09c48878d.json reports GREEN, COVERAGE, check-types, and lint exit 0. It reports 1,388 cases, 91.64% line coverage, and the 85.52% coverage floor.

The gate and plan cite both F19 mutation logs. The contact sky-300 mutation exits 1 at the contrast assertion. The slate-400 pricing mutation exits 1 because the unsupported foreground value throws; this is fail-closed, but it does not prove that this token's numeric ratio was computed.

A hand calculation using the standard OKLab-to-linear-sRGB matrices maps oklch(0.627955 0.257683 29.234) to (255, 0, 0), matching pure red. The conversion constants in fixtures/contrast.ts:48–61 implement those matrices.

F20 evidence: fixtures/contrast.ts:188–193 catches parse errors and continues to a parent; lines 189–190 blend a translucent color against the page constant. A translucent child over a non-white opaque ancestor therefore uses the wrong backdrop. An unsupported painted background is skipped instead of throwing.

contrast-fixture.test.ts:8–26 covers the gray/cream ratio, black/white ratio, and unresolved foreground syntax. It does not test translucent background composition, ancestor compositing, or unresolved painted backgrounds.
